assertion.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 ships a bug fix whose title says behavior "return[s] to DoNotSchedule", but the note does not identify which mechanism, setting, field or component is affected.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The single-line bug-fix title names only the target behavior 'DoNotSchedule'; it does not state what 'DoNotSchedule' refers to (which taint, field, value, flag or component), so the subject identity cannot be pinned (semantic-ambiguity).; applicability: The note names no setting, flag, resource, taint, feature gate or version condition, and the affected mechanism itself is unidentified, so no exposure predicate can be written from the evidence (evidence-gap).; consequence: The note states only that behavior returns to DoNotSchedule; it does not say what an affected environment experiences, what fails, or what an operator must do.
